newsitem.title: UK: OFTEL makes switching mobile phone networks easier.
newsitem.headline: OFTEL makes switching mobile phone networks easier.

text.p: British telecommunications regulator OFTEL said on Thursday that from next year mobile phone users would be able to retain their numbers after switching over to another network.
At the moment mobile operators do not allow customers to take their numbers with them if they switch to a rival operator.

OFTEL's directive means that from next July Britain's four mobile operators Cellnet, Vodafone, Orange and One2One should have to offer "number portability" -- the right for customers switching networks to take their number with them.
"The mobile phone market is becoming more competitive and mobile phone users want to make the most of this by choosing the best deal around," Don Cuickshank, head of OFTEL said in a statement.
